Company: CloudWave Systems
Position: Full Stack Software Engineering Intern
Location: Austin, TX
Duration: 3 months internship (Summer 2025)

About the Role:
CloudWave Systems is seeking an enthusiastic Software Engineering Intern to join our developer tooling team. You will build and scale cloud-native web applications, contribute to responsive user interfaces, and collaborate with experienced engineers on distributed systems.

Key Responsibilities:
• Build modern frontend dashboards and collaboration interfaces using React and modern component libraries.
• Develop robust backend microservices and RESTful API endpoints utilizing Python and Node.js.
• Work with document databases like MongoDB to design performant query aggregations and schemas.
• Containerize application services using Docker and integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.

Required Qualifications:
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
• Hands-on programming experience with Python and JavaScript / TypeScript.
• Solid working knowledge of React frontend development and Node.js backend services.
• Practical understanding of Docker containers and relational or NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or PostgreSQL.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Familiarity with FastAPI or modern asynchronous Python frameworks.
• Knowledge of Git version control and GitHub Actions workflows.
